channel.title: The Munsif Daily - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Munsif Daily (munsifdaily.com)

item.title: Delhi-NCR’s air quality improves slightly to ‘very poor’
item.description: The National Capital Region witnessed a marginal respite from choking pollution on Wednesday, as air quality improved to the 'very poor' category and the Air Quality Index (AQI) stood at 349, according to data released by the Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB).

item.title: TN schools barred from holding special classes during Christmas holidays
item.description: The Directorate of School Education and the Directorate of Private Schools have issued strict instructions to all schools across Tamil Nadu not to engage students in special classes of any kind during the ongoing Christmas holidays, which began on Tuesday and will continue till January 4.

item.title: ‘BJP’s open-door policy to purify corrupt Oppn leaders deep contention for loyalists’: Shiv Sena(UBT) in Saamana
item.description: The Thackeray camp in the party's mouthpiece, 'Saamana', said this open-door policy has emerged as a point of deep contention for party veterans.

item.title: Rights body raises alarm over enforced disappearances of women in Balochistan
item.description: A leading human rights organisation expressed serious concern over the alarming rise in enforced disappearances of women in Balochistan by Pakistan’s security forces and intelligence agencies.

item.title: Three of family killed in road accident: Karnatak
item.description: Three members of a family were killed on the spot while two others were injured in a road accident near Devinagar Camp in Karnataka's Ballari district in the early hours of Wednesday.

item.title: PM Modi to inaugurate Rashtra Prerna Sthal in UP tomorrow
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Uttar Pradesh on Thursday (December 25) on the occasion of the 101st birth anniversary of former Prime Minister Bharat Ratna Atal Bihari Vajpayee and will inaugurate Rashtra Prerna Sthal in Lucknow.

item.title: BlueBird-6: Know all about India’s heaviest-ever satellite, carried by ISRO’s ‘Baahubali’ rocket
item.description: The Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO) successfully launched BlueBird 6, the heaviest satellite yet, aboard its 'Baahubali' Launch Vehicle Mark-3 (LVM3)-M6 rocket on Wednesday.

item.title: Pakistan’s deep state behind atrocities against Hindus in bangladesh: Baloch activist
item.description: Leading Baloch human rights defender, Mir Yar Baloch, on Wednesday accused Pakistan's deep state of the escalating incidents of mob lynching, hate-driven violence, and targeted attacks against the Hindu community in Bangladesh.

item.title: Vaibhav Suyavanshi hits 36-ball ton for Bihar in Vijay Hazare Trophy opener
item.description: India's 14-year-old batting sensation, Vaibhav Suryavanshi, made headlines again after smashing a 36-ball century in the Vijay Hazare Trophy Plate league opener for Bihar against Arunachal Pradesh at the JSCA Oval Ground on Wednesday.

item.title: Andhra Pradesh Governor, CM congratulate ISRO for LVM3-M6 launch
item.description: Andhra Pradesh Governor S. Abdul Nazeer and Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu have congratulated ISRO scientists for the successful launch of LVM3-M6 mission from the Satish Dhawan Space Centre in Sriharikota on Wednesday and placing in orbit the BlueBird-6 Satellite.
